review:
Sweet Bonanza squeezed onto a 3x5 grid – the fastest-feeling game in the series, with a 97.05% RTP, one of Pragmatic's best defaults. Five or more matching symbols anywhere pay up to 50x, with tumbles.

Three or more scatters or POP symbols give 10 free spins with candy bombs up to 1,000x that add up at the end of each sequence. One, two or three POP symbols in the trigger also pay a 50x, 500x or 25,000x jackpot. Quick spins with a jackpot on top.
pros: Excellent 97.05% RTP – among the highest published
Second route to big wins via respins or jackpots
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Pragmatic Play doesn't publish a volatility rating for this game
Short-session results can differ widely from the long-term average
